rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: AgentUtil Think provides intent security for autonomous AI agents. It offers pre-flight safety checklists before risky actions, instruction expansion to surface implicit requirements, and post-action review for verification. Part of the AgentUtil suite of utility APIs designed for AI agents with no-signup JSON-in/JSON-out access and pay-per-request pricing.
